briefings.title: Marco Rubio Drops Hammer on Iran: 'Total Defeat' or Prosperity — Choose | 5/6/26
briefings.tldr: Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the conclusion of Operation Epic Fury and the launch of "Project Freedom" to counter Iran's blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, as skyrocketing domestic gas prices and dueling speeches by Rubio and Vice President JD Vance heat up early speculation for the 2028 GOP presidential ticket.
